scenario: AITA for not directly paying my friend for half of the gas used on a trip? | I will keep this short. We went on a trip and used two tanks of gas. 1 tank there and 1 tank back. His argument was that since I didn't pay for it myself it didn't count, I think it does count since I still supplied us with half the tank and my method of acquiring the gas shouldn't matter. We did use his car but it shouldn't matter since we had used my car for the last trip which was roughly the same distance and it was his turn to provide the vehicle. AITA?
